---
title: "Load counts from big CSV files"
output: html_notebook
---


```{r,message=FALSE}
library(SingleCellExperiment)
library(scater)
library(BiocParallel)
library(BiocSingular)
bp <-BiocParallel::MulticoreParam(10)
```


Sometime gene expression matrices are given into big CSV or tab-delimited files.
This notebook show how to convert them into H5 format.


# Demo with GEO dataset GSE190012
https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/geo/query/acc.cgi?acc=GSE213828 

```{r}
count_m <- read.delim("GSE213828/GSE213828_merged_counts.txt.gz")
metaD <- read.delim("GSE213828/GSE213828_merged_sample_info.txt.gz",row.names = "qp_well_fq")

o <- SingleCellExperiment(list(counts=data.matrix(count_m[,-1:-2])),
                     rowData=count_m[,1:2],
                     colData=metaD,mainExpName = "Gene Expression")
rownames(o) <- make.unique(mcols(o)$gene_name)
```



# QC 

## Compute QC metrics

```{r}
o <- scuttle::addPerCellQCMetrics(o,
                                         subsets=list(mt=grep("^mt-",rownames(o)),Rp=grep("^Rp",rownames(o))), 
                                         BPPARAM=bp)
```

### Transcriptomics

```{r}
o$qc <- "pass"
o$qc[o$subsets_Rp_percent >= 15] <- "rna_high_Rp"
o$qc[o$subsets_mt_percent >= 15] <- "rna_high_mt"
o$qc[o$detected < 1000] <- "rna_low_detected"
o$qc[o$sum < 1000] <- "rna_low_count"
```


```{r}
ggcells(o) + 
  geom_bar(aes(fill=qc,y=q_plate),color="black") + 
  ylab("")
```




### Read count

```{r}
ggcells(o) + 
  geom_violin(aes(x=sum,y=q_plate),scale="width") + 
  geom_vline(xintercept=min(o$sum[o$qc %in% "pass"]),linetype=2) + 
  scale_x_log10() + 
  xlab("Read count") + ylab("")
```



### Detected genes

```{r}
ggcells(o) + 
  geom_violin(aes(x=detected,y=q_plate),scale="width") + 
  geom_vline(xintercept=min(o$detected[o$qc %in% "pass"]),linetype=2) + 
  xlab("Num. detected gene") + ylab("")
```



### Mitochondrial genes

```{r}
ggcells(o) + 
  geom_violin(aes(x=subsets_mt_percent,y=q_plate),scale="width") + 
  geom_vline(xintercept=max(o$subsets_mt_percent[o$qc %in% "pass"]),linetype=2) +
  xlab("% Mitochondrial") + ylab("")
```




### Ribosomal proteins

```{r}
ggcells(o) + 
  geom_violin(aes(x=subsets_Rp_percent,y=q_plate),scale="width") + 
  geom_vline(xintercept=max(o$subsets_Rp_percent[o$qc %in% "pass"]),linetype=2) +
  xlab("% Ribosomal protein") + ylab("")
```



### Read-count / Detected-gene

```{r}
ggcells(o) + 
  geom_point(aes(x=sum,y=detected,color=qc)) + 
  scale_x_log10() + 
  xlab("Read count") + ylab("Num. detected gene") + theme(legend.position = "none")

```




# Expression Normalization

```{r}
o <- o[,o$qc %in% "pass"]
o <- logNormCounts(o,BPPARAM=bp)
```


# Dimensionality reduction

## PCA

```{r}
o <- runPCA(o,BSPARAM=IrlbaParam(),BPPARAM=bp)
```


```{r}
ggcells(o) + 
  geom_point(aes(x=PCA.1,y=PCA.2,color=log10(detected))) + 
  coord_equal()

ggcells(o) + 
  geom_point(aes(x=PCA.1,y=PCA.2,color=q_plate)) + 
  coord_equal()
```

## UMAP

```{r}
set.seed(123456)
o <- runUMAP(o,dimred="PCA",BPPARAM=bp)
```


```{r}
ggcells(o) + 
  geom_point(aes(x=UMAP.1,y=UMAP.2,color=log10(detected))) + 
  coord_equal()

ggcells(o) + 
  geom_point(aes(x=UMAP.1,y=UMAP.2,color=q_plate)) + 
  coord_equal()
```


#Save object

```{r}
ABAData::writeSingleCellExperiment(o, "qc_filtered_exp")
```
